TradeCorrectionIn.description:
A correction is a full replacement (002a 3a). name/asset_type/market_session may stay null only where the target's
value is null; brokerage_fee and taxes must both be stated when the target's charges were not provided (an explicit
"0" counts). Omitted and JSON null both mean "not supplied". The service checks these against the target.
TradeCorrectionIn.title: TradeCorrectionIn

TradeIn.description: A NEW manual trade: the ISIN is required (002a 1b); the format is validated by the service.
TradeIn.title: TradeIn

post.description:
Transport only: stream the single `file` part (2 MiB cap enforced while reading), then hand it to the service.

The service parses before it takes the user lock and owns the transaction. It is synchronous, so it runs in the
thread pool rather than on the event loop. File-level failures are 422 `invalid_import_file`; a held lock is 409.
